comments.author: pjmlp
comments.why: Stroustrup on why he started C with Classes.
comments.text: It is, after being forced to use BCPL to finish his PhD and being used to languages like Simula, Bjarne swore he wouldn't be doing that again. Hence why he started to design C with Classes after getting his job at AT&T. [VIDEO] Around 29:00.

comments.author: pjmlp
comments.story: Is Java more secure than C?
comments.why: Stroustrup's compromises with C given his employer.
comments.text: Yeah, I should have let the "just" out. There are a whole class of errors caused by C's memory corruption "feature" that I can happily live without. C tosses safety away, because its designers were lazy to implement a proper compiler given what the computing world was doing outside AT&T. Bjarne wasn't also quite found of it, but he had to compromise to get adoption, given his employer. [VIDEO]
